public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Planted Solar is a Series A-stage climate and energy company that has raised $32M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 firms in the Climate & Energy sector, including one public company (Lenza, ticker LNZA) and eight private peers such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The stage-progression method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. Using total raised of $32M as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-stage progression, this method implies a valuation of $64M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied due to insufficient narrow comparables at the same stage and tier within the Climate & Energy sector; while 8 same-sector peers exist, none met the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier datapoints (minimum 3 required), making sector-wide medians potentially misleading.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $54M to $74M, centered on $64M. This range reflects a ±15% confidence band around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the tightness of the Series A comp set in frontier climate tech, where deal velocity and capital structures vary materially, and the degree to which total-raised serves as a reliable ex-ante proxy for post-investment valuation in a nascent sector.
